sources.entry: Spotifly - Lightweight Spotify player focused on fast playback control. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/ralph/Spotifly) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Spotifly is a lightweight, native SwiftUI Spotify player for macOS that can also act as a Spotify Connect device.
summary.what_it_does: Spotifly is a macOS app for playing Spotify with a focus on speed and light resource use. It shows your playlists, albums, followed artists and liked songs, and lets you search the catalog and manage favorites. Playback controls and a queue with drag-and-drop reordering are included. Keyboard shortcuts cover play/pause, next/previous track, liking tracks, and jumping between sections. The README says the Mac registers as a Spotify Connect device, so you can play audio here or control other Connect devices from it. Installation is either a direct ZIP download or a Homebrew formula.
use_cases: Play Spotify on a Mac with a lightweight app
Control Spotify Connect speakers or phone from the desktop
Manage playlists, albums and liked songs
Reorder a playback queue with drag and drop
Install a Spotify client via Homebrew
how_to_run: Direct download: grab the latest release ZIP from the project's releases page
Move Spotifly.app to your Applications folder
Open Spotifly from Applications and click Connect with Spotify
Or install via Homebrew: brew install ralph/spotifly/spotifly
stack: Ogg Vorbis via libogg and libvorbis
notable: Native macOS app built with SwiftUI
Acts as a Spotify Connect device, so one authorization signs in and enables Connect
Keyboard shortcuts for playback and navigation (Cmd+1 to Cmd+4 sections, Cmd+L to like)
Installable through Homebrew or direct download
